```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
```


## Load TCRs from RNA-seq & TCR-seq data

```{r Load TCRs from RNA-seq data}
# From RNA-seq
tcr1 = readRDS('rna-seq/results/tcr_mat.rds')

tcr1[1:4, 1:4]

dim(tcr1)

summary(colMeans(tcr1))

# From TCR-seq: tumors + blood
tcr2 = readRDS('tcr-seq/results/tcr_mat_blood.rds')

tcr2[1:4, 1:4]

dim(tcr2)

summary(colMeans(tcr2))

# From TCR-seq: tumors only
tcr3 = readRDS('tcr-seq/results/tcr_mat_tumor.rds')

tcr3[1:4, 1:4]

dim(tcr3)

summary(colMeans(tcr3))
```

## Compare RNA-seq & TCR-seq merging tumors and blood

```{r}
# Sample overlap
mean(rownames(tcr2) %in% rownames(tcr1))

# TCR overlap
mean(colnames(tcr1) %in% colnames(tcr2))

# TCR overlap when looking at common samples
common_samples = intersect(rownames(tcr1), rownames(tcr2))

subset_tcr1 = tcr1[common_samples, ]
subset_tcr1 = subset_tcr1[, colSums(subset_tcr1) > 0]

subset_tcr2 = tcr2[common_samples, ]
subset_tcr2 = subset_tcr2[, colSums(subset_tcr2) > 0]
  
mean(colnames(subset_tcr1) %in% colnames(subset_tcr2))

# Correlations
common_tcrs = intersect(colnames(subset_tcr1), colnames(subset_tcr2))

subset_tcr1 = subset_tcr1[, common_tcrs]
subset_tcr2 = subset_tcr2[, common_tcrs]

cors = sapply(common_tcrs, function(tcr) cor(subset_tcr1[, tcr], subset_tcr2[, tcr], method = 'sp'))

hist(cors, breaks = 100)

# Test 1
test_tcrs = common_tcrs[cors > 0.99]

length(test_tcrs)

summary(colMeans(subset_tcr1[, test_tcrs]))

summary(colMeans(subset_tcr2[, test_tcrs]))

# Test 2
test_tcrs = common_tcrs[cors < 0]

length(test_tcrs)

summary(colMeans(subset_tcr1[, test_tcrs]))

summary(colMeans(subset_tcr2[, test_tcrs]))
```
